summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (Ordinary and Extraordinary), a routine corporate governance event. Shareholders approved the 2025 financial statements, allocated net profit of €4.429 billion to reserves, set a total dividend of €1.1 per share, appointed the board and statutory auditors for a three-year term, approved a long-term incentive plan for 2026-2028, and authorized treasury share purchases and cancellations. The board confirmed Claudio Descalzi as CEO. No transaction, strategic review, or activist campaign is disclosed.
